card.name: Word just before adverse reactions
card.fires_on: The word "serious" (or "see", or the end of "esophageal") right before "adverse reactions" or a cross-reference to Warnings sections in drug labels. Also a stray space after "around" before a number.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A lone space after "around" in a news sentence about money, just before the figure.
modes.example: victims worldwide lose around<< >>290 euros billion each year.
